description: This file defines the AddressHelper class, which provides static methods for converting between R1C1 and A1 cell reference formats, parsing formulas with R1C1 references, and handling related cell address manipulations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: AddressHelper
classes.description: Utility class for converting cell addresses between R1C1 and A1 formats and parsing related formulas.

methods.name: getRowAndColumnChars
methods.description: Retrieves the row and column prefix characters used in cell references, adapting to compatibility mode.

methods.name: convertToA1
methods.description: Converts an R1C1 format cell address to A1 format, considering current position and localization.

methods.name: convertSpreadsheetMLFormula
methods.description: Processes SpreadsheetML formulas to adapt certain syntax elements.

methods.name: convertFormulaToA1
methods.description: Converts formulas with R1C1 references to A1 format, including handling quoted strings.

methods.name: convertToR1C1
methods.description: Converts an A1 format cell address to R1C1 format, optionally relative to a current position.
